independence: Reviewer did not design the frozen inputs or run model generation. Reviewer previously performed read-only product/runner review and the 2B semantic audit, and knew the 4B selection and outputs were from 4B. This is an informed paired review, not a blinded or independent second-human rating. No model, prompt, fixture, pipeline or output was modified for this review.
review_policy: Every expected checkpoint is retained per raw/postprocessed stage. Claims are reviewed at exact JSON paths, with explicit source segment IDs and rationale.
Semantic verdict is independent of schema validity. A valid JSON structure does not establish faithful content.
Readable translation and punctuation-only changes to excerpts are allowed. Required omissions are recorded within their designated product module.
Unanchored Friday/Monday remains relative. No absolute date/time, unassigned owner, imagined option, task substitution, or inferred approval is accepted as a source fact.
Neutral schema-required priority/status defaults such as medium/open are not read as explicit meeting commitments. Explicit nonneutral urgency or fabricated actions are reviewed on their own merits.
needs_review marks uncertainty but cannot authorize an invented decision or task. A clearly pending decision placeholder is not called an approved decision.
A truncated raw output can contain observable semantic errors. Unseen suffix and absent postprocessed payload remain unobserved; no repaired partial JSON is supplied to the product.
Timeline semantic support is assessed against the relevant source segment, not only overall duration bounds.
The five registered cases intentionally target observed 2B failures. Their pass counts must not be presented as general meeting success rates.

Use the same material standards as 2B. Unknown decision owners, unsupported nonneutral high priority, invented causal claims, task/negation/attribution errors and incorrect source positioning block the material gate. Minor editorial modality or required qualifier omissions remain separate from material errors.
Task/owner/due checkpoints assess their named content fields; unsupported priority is separately enforced by all-claims and the material gate. A passing task checkpoint is never a complete-case pass.
English unknown synonyms Unassigned/Undetermined have clear unknown semantics even when closed literal field constraints reject spelling; do not call these semantic assignment/date hallucinations.
Every completed overview/module can be audited for its required omissions; incomplete suffix modules stay unobserved. Cross-module facts and negative claims are checked explicitly.

summary.counting_unit: Five paired model requests selected from the same frozen eight-case suite. Prefix-03 and final share the same six-segment story and are not independent meetings. Raw/postprocessed are paired representations, not ten samples. The set is deliberately enriched for 2B failures, not a representative population success rate.
summary.strict_schema_and_nontruncation_gate: fail: both correction cases end with length and have no valid product payload.
summary.recommended_next_step: Stop stage B under the registered rule. Leave mixed-design-review-final, prefix-01 and prefix-02 not_run_by_stop_rule. Do not run more generations, concurrent ASR/LS-EEND, or change product configuration from this negative screen.
observed_improvements: Sound-check abstention is a complete faithful response.
Relative Friday/Monday are preserved in visible action fields.
Chinese task restores test-environment verification; English restores checklist identity and offline decision.
Visible correction outputs distinguish demo checklist from risk list, retain Ren/Monday and keep risk owner/date unknown.
remaining_limitations: Chinese/English complete packages still have material unsupported owner/priority or rationale/timeline problems.
Both correction outputs contain visible material errors and are truncated; final regresses from 2B completeness.
The absence of an old error in a truncated output does not prove the missing suffix would remain faithful.
No repetitive reliability estimate, unseen-case generalization, concurrency result, or product UI behavior is established.
summary.performance_interpretation: Sound-check becomes shorter and faster in this observation. The other four 4B generations take longer than their paired 2B runs; both correction runs spend about 31 seconds and still do not produce a package. Timing is descriptive, not a causal or repeated model-size benchmark.
